paite: Atawp pen in unaute aw, Toupa ah kipak un. Angei mah gelh kei a ding in achimtakhuai kei a, nou a ding in ahoihzaw hi.
heading: Khrist Suan Ding Ahi

paite: Uite lak ah kiveng un, nna gilou semte a pan kiveng un, sa atgawp mite a pan kiveng un.
Eite lah Kha a Pathian bia, Khrist Jesu suang, zeksum diktakte i hi ngal ua, huan pumpi ah suan ding i nei kei uhi.
Sa ah suang ding chi lehang kei mahmah in suan ding ka nei sem ding hi. Mi himhim in asa a suan ding nei a akitheihleh ke'n ka nei sem hi.
Ani giat ni a zeksum, Israel chi, Benjamin nam, Hebru mi kholdiak, dan lam a Pharisai;
phatuamngaihna lam chi lehang saptuamte sawi; dan a diktatna lam chi lehang gensiatbei ka hi.
Ahihi hitaleh, kei a dia punna ka ngah thilte peuhmah Khrist ziak in manna in ka simta hi.
Ahitak in, ka Toupa theihna manpha ziak in thil tengteng ka tanta hi. Khrist ka tantheihna ding in thil tengteng ninneng bang phet in ka sim hi.
Amah a ka omtheihna ding in leh dan a kinga keimah diktatna hilou a, Khrist ginna ziak a om pen, ginna a kinga Pathian a pan suak diktatna nei zaw in.
Huchi a amah leh athohnawnna thilhihtheihna ka theih a, athuaknate tanpih a, asihna a amah batna ka neihtheihna ding in.
Bangchi hiam a misi lak a kipan thohnawnna ka ngah theih khakleh chi in.
Hiai tang khin ka hi kei a, bukim khinta ka hi kei; himahleh huai mah kei a hihsak tum in ka delh teitei hi, Khrist Jesu'n kei, amah a ahon hihsak tak ziak in.
heading: Phakchiam Delhna

paite: Unaute aw, tang khinta in ka kingai kei a; himahleh thil khat ka hih hi: nunglam a omte mangngilh in malam a om pen ka delh hi;
Khrist Jesu a Pathian sapna sang kipahman mu ding in phakchiamna ka delh hi.
Huaiziak in i lak ua apiching deuhdeuh bek in huchibang lungsim i nei ding uh; huchi a thil peuhpeuh a lungsim dang na neih uleh Pathian in nou ahon theisak ngei ding hi.
I hong tunna i ngahna chiang uah muanhuai in kip peuhmah ni uh.
Unaute aw, kei hon enton vek unla huchibang a omte zuih ding a na hon neihte uh chiamteh un.
heading: Van Khua-le-tui

paite: Mi tampi a-om ua, atanchin uh ka hon hilhta hi, amau Khrist kros melmate ahihdan uh tu in leng kap kawm in ka hon hilh hi.
Lei lam thil ngaihtuahte zaw atawpna uh siatna ahi a, apathian uh agilpi uh ahi a, athupina uh leng adaina uh ahi.
I khua-le-tui hihna uh zaw van ah ahi zaw a; huai a kipan mah in Toupa Jesu Khrist hondampa i ngak uhi.
I pumpi thulim lou amah thupina pumpi toh kibang ding in, ahon bawlthaksak ding a, thil bangkim ama thuthu a a-omsak theihna thilhihtheihna in.
